snippet.title: This Mannequin Shouldn’t Move… | Mannequin Syndrome v1.0.5
snippet.description:
Early alpha gameplay preview showcasing atmosphere, mannequin AI, and core survival systems.
A quiet forest, an abandoned facility, and a threat that should never move.

This video highlights Mannequin Syndrome v1.0.5, an early alpha build focused on laying the foundation of the game’s horror experience.

In this preview, I showcase the forest map, current mannequin AI behavior, and core gameplay systems such as the flashlight, stamina mechanics, and environmental interaction. This build is all about testing atmosphere, pacing, and player tension before introducing major new features.

Current build highlights:
🌲 Forest map & abandoned facility
🧍 Mannequin AI behavior (early version)
🔦 Flashlight system
🏃 Stamina-based movement
🎮 Core survival gameplay elements

⚠️ Major update coming soon, including:
⚡ New mannequin designs
⚡ Night vision replacing the flashlight
⚡ GPS navigation system
⚡ In-game shop system
⚡ New maps & expanded objectives

💀 Wishlist Mannequin Syndrome on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3722510/Mannequin_Syndrome/

💬 Join the official Discord for updates & playtesting:
https://discord.gg/M3WYHq7Fnb

Mannequin Syndrome is a psychological survival horror experience focused on tension, observation, and unpredictable AI behavior. Feedback is always welcome as development continues.

#IndieHorror #HorrorGame #GameDev #Unity #SurvivalHorror #PsychologicalHorror #WIP
